header:
Resets the feature-demo load arena: stores SEQ_SONG_SLOTS (the arena start) in the next-free pointer at RAM 0x25B7E that FDemo_AllocBuffer bumps.
Basis: callers + body -- FDemo_DisplayResourceData calls it once after opening the .SQT file and before allocating a 256-byte FDemo_AllocBuffer block per file block.
evidence: demo/file_demo_proc.s:37 `call FileIO_OpenWithMode` / 40 `jrl lt, FDemo_DisplayResourceData_Skip6` / 41 `calr FDemo_DisplayResourceData_Helper` -- caller resets once, right after a successful open
demo/file_demo_proc.s:47 `ld xwa, 256` / 48 `calr FDemo_AllocBuffer` -- then allocates per 256-byte block (also 67, 96)
demo/file_demo_proc.s:116 `lda xwa, (SEQ_SONG_SLOTS:24)` / 117 `ld (0x25b7e:24), xwa` -- body: pointer := arena start
demo/file_demo_proc.s:124 `lda xhl, (SEQ_SONG_SLOTS:24)` / 128 `ld xde, (0x25b7e:24)` / 136 `ld (0x25b7e:24), xde` -- FDemo_AllocBuffer reads and advances the same pointer

header:
Copies name XWA into the first free entry (data pointer at +16 == 0) of the 63-entry, 24-byte loaded-file table at RAM 0x249D8 and stores data pointer XBC at +16; HL = 1, or 0 when the table is full.
Basis: callers + body -- FDemo_FileOpenAndProcess, after FDemo_LinkedListSearchInsert found the name neither in this table nor in the ROM directory, reads the whole file into an FDemo_AllocBuffer block, closes it and registers name + block here.
evidence: demo/file_demo_proc.s:493 `lda xwa, (xsp+10)` / 494 `calr FDemo_LinkedListSearchInsert` / 496 `jr z, FDemo_FileOpen_DoOpen` -- caller only loads when the name is not found yet

demo/file_demo_proc.s:412 `lda xwa, (0x249d8:24)` .. 420 `call Strcmp` / 424 `ld xwa, 24` / 427 `cp iz, 63` -- the lookup side walks the same 63 x 24-byte RAM table by name, then falls back to the ROM directory at (0x880008)
demo/file_demo_proc.s:512 `ld xwa, xiz` / 513 `calr FDemo_AllocBuffer` .. 520 `call FileIO_ReadBlock` -- caller reads the whole file into the arena block
demo/file_demo_proc.s:523 `lda xwa, (xsp+10)` / 524 `ld xbc, (xsp+6)` / 525 `calr FDemo_LinkedListLookupField_Helper` -- XWA = file name, XBC = the loaded block

demo/file_demo_proc.s:458 `push xwa` / 459 `push xiz` / 460 `call Strcpy` / 463 `ld (xiz+16), xwa` / 464 `ld hl, 1:i3` -- copy name, store pointer, return 1 (0 at 467 when full)
ui/ui_window_procs.s:1593 `call FDemo_LinkedListLookupField` / 1598 `call DrawBitmapFile` -- the stored pointer is later drawn as a bitmap by name

header:
For owner A, builds the slot assignment list at RAM 0x7A0 from the block list at RAM 0x6D4: the large block (entry 0) gets the first of the 4 large slots whose owner byte is 0 or A, each following block the next such small slot (of 40); records are {block, 0x500 | slot} with bit 7 set for small slots.
Basis: callers + body -- Flash_InitBytecodeBlock runs it first on its write path (no shortfall), with A = its owner argument (CstmCp's 0x39B7); Flash_WriteSlotOwnerMap and Flash_CopyBlocksToSlots consume the list.

header:
Copies the 64 KB section-7 sector into its RAM image at (0x0C96), writes owner A into the owner byte of every slot in the assignment list at RAM 0x7A0, clears A from the remaining slots after them, then erases and rewrites the sector (Flash_EraseSectorAndWrite).
Basis: callers + body -- Flash_InitBytecodeBlock calls it on its write path after Flash_AssignSlotsToBlocks built the list, with the same owner A.

header:
Copies every block in the assignment list at RAM 0x7A0 from the RAM work area at 0x1E0000 into its slot in the RAM image of the section-7 sector (large block 10,535 bytes, small blocks 470), then erases and rewrites the sector.
Basis: callers + body -- Flash_InitBytecodeBlock calls it right after Flash_WriteSlotOwnerMap on its write path; TmFlash_WriteRoutine supplies the source and destination addresses.
